title: Talent Acquisition Manager - India
description:
**Date:** Oct 15, 2026

  

**Location:** Pune, MH, IN, 410501

  

**Company:** Corning

  

Requisition Number: 78676

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Corning’s businesses are ever-evolving to best serve our customers, industries, and consumers. Today, we accelerate and transform life sciences, mobile consumer electronics, optical communications, display, automotive, and solar markets. We are changing the world with:

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low-cost solar energy solutions
  

**Role Purpose**
----------------

The Talent Acquisition Manager - India will lead recruitment strategy and delivery across Corning India, supporting talent needs across Manufacturing, Engineering, Technology, R&D, Commercial, Corporate Functions, and Leadership hiring.

This role serves as a strategic talent partner to business leaders and HR teams, responsible for workforce planning, recruitment execution, employer branding, talent market intelligence, and recruitment operations. The incumbent will lead hiring initiatives that support business growth, manufacturing expansion, organizational transformation, and future workforce scaling while ensuring an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.

As part of Corning's Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence, the role will also contribute to regional and global talent acquisition initiatives, best practices, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Talent Acquisition Strategy & Business Partnership**

* Develop and execute the India Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Partner with business leaders and HR teams to forecast talent needs and build effective hiring strategies.
* Provide talent market intelligence, competitive insights, and workforce planning recommendations.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on recruitment, talent availability, and hiring best practices.

**Recruitment Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment across all functions and levels, including manufacturing, engineering, technology, R&D, commercial, corporate, and leadership hiring.
* Ensure delivery of hiring targets, service levels, and workforce commitments.
* Personally lead critical, hard-to-fill, and executive-level searches where required.
* Support large-scale hiring initiatives related to business growth, expansion projects, and organizational transformation.

**Operations & Vendor Management**

* Oversee Talent Acquisition operations, recruitment processes, and governance across India.
* Manage RPO partners, recruitment agencies, and external talent suppliers to ensure high-quality delivery.
* Monitor recruiting metrics, budget utilization, sourcing effectiveness, and hiring performance.
* Drive process improvements through the effective use of ATS, CRM, and recruitment technologies.

**Employer Branding & Talent Attraction**

* Strengthen Corning's employer brand through targeted attraction strategies and market engagement.
* Lead campus recruiting, graduate hiring, internship programs, and early-career initiatives.
* Build sustainable talent pipelines through partnerships with universities, industry associations, and talent communities.
* Collaborate with HR and Communications teams to enhance Corning's employee value proposition.

**Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain recruitment analytics, dashboards, and workforce planning metrics.
* Analyze hiring trends, sourcing performance, and recruitment effectiveness to support business decisions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on hiring quality, candidate experience, and operational efficiency.

**Projects & Transformation**

* Support talent acquisition activities related to expansion projects, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, and workforce transformation initiatives.
* Participate in regional and global TA projects, capability-building programs, and implementation of new recruiting tools and best practices.

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree required.
* Master's Degree or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience within multinational organizations.
* Proven success leading recruitment across manufacturing, engineering, technology, commercial, corporate, and leadership functions.
* Experience managing recruitment teams, RPO providers, and agency partners.
* Strong background in workforce planning, employer branding, campus recruitment, and large-scale hiring programs.
* Exposure to regional or global recruitment environments is preferred.

**Experiences/Education - Desired**
-----------------------------------

* Strong Talent Acquisition leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term planning and operational execution.
* Expertise in workforce planning, talent analytics, and recruitment technologies.
* Strong project management, problem-solving, and change management skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and presentation abilities.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple business units, geographies, and stakeholders.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* Approximately 20-30% domestic travel within India.
* Occasional international travel as required

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**Job Description- Talent Acquisition Intern**

**Company:** Karnex Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Position:** Talent Acquisition Intern  
**Location:** Baner, Pune  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹10,000 per month

**About the Role**

Karnex Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Talent Acquisition Intern to support our recruitment team. This internship offers hands-on experience in the end-to-end recruitment process, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and talent engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
* Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules, feedback, and hiring updates.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Support the recruitment team in managing walk-in drives and bulk hiring activities.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Assist with recruitment reports, documentation, and other talent acquisition activities.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or currently pursuing a degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.
* Ability to multitask and manage deadlines effectively.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced recruitment environment.
* Proactive attitude with strong organizational skills.

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands-on exposure to end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience working with job portals and candidate sourcing tools.
* Understanding of interview coordination and candidate management.
* Opportunity to learn from experienced HR professionals.
* Practical experience in corporate HR and talent acquisition.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Hiring: Senior Manager E-learning Sales
company: TechnoEdge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company:** Technoedge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** Pune (Baner)  
**Employment Type:** Full Time (On-site)  
**Experience Required:** 3 to 5 Years

**About TechnoEdge**  
TechnoEdge Learning Services India Pvt Ltd is an enterprise learning company on a mission to deliver innovative, customized, and outcome-driven learning solutions that move organizations forward. We work with 185+ leading enterprises across industries, offering a full-spectrum portfolio custom eLearning, digital learning content, corporate training, microlearning, AI-powered media solutions, multilingual dubbing and localisation, and talent development consulting. With 27,000+ professionals trained and 793+ domain trainers in our network, we don't just build learning programs we build learning ecosystems.

**The Role**  
TechnoEdge is looking for a senior enterprise sales professional to own new business acquisition for our learning content and digital learning portfolio. This is a pure new business role. You will prospect, engage, and close enterprise clients independently — from first conversation to signed contract. No account farming. No team management. Full revenue ownership.

**What You Will Own**

1. End-to-end enterprise sales cycle — prospecting, discovery, solution positioning, proposal, negotiation, closure  
2. New logo acquisition and quarterly revenue targets  
3. Pipeline creation and CRM hygiene across all active opportunities  
4. Executive relationships at CHRO, CLO, L&D Head, and Talent leadership levels

**Who We Are Looking For**  
You currently work or have recently worked in enterprise sales at a learning content, e Learning, or talent development company. You have sold custom eLearning, digital learning solutions, microlearning, or learning consulting services to mid-to-large enterprises. You understand how L&D buying decisions are made, and you have the relationships and credibility to open doors at the right level.

Specifically, you bring:  
1. 3-5 years total experience; minimum 3 years in enterprise learning sales  
2. A clean track record of new logo acquisition and consistent quota achievement  
3. Comfort engaging CHROs, CLOs, L&D Heads, and Procurement in complex sales cycles 4. Commercial sharpness - you understand deal structures, pricing, and value-based selling CRM discipline and reliable forecasting as a standard work habit, not an afterthought  
5. Strong professional network within the L&D and corporate training ecosystem

**What TechnoEdge Offers**  
1. Direct ownership of your market with leadership visibility and zero bureaucracy 2.Competitive fixed compensation + performance incentives on new business  
3. A growing portfolio of learning content and digital learning products to sell with conviction

This role is not suitable for candidates from outside the learning industry, those seeking account management or team leadership responsibilities, or those without a demonstrated enterprise new business track record.

**Apply:** hr@technoedgels.com  
**Contact:** 9225375293

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (F/M) - Permanent - Pune
description:
#### **Shape the future of industrial transformation with We.PLM !**


Join We.PLM, a fast\-growing PLM consulting firm and Dassault Systèmes partner, supporting leading industrial companies across Western Europe. Our growth is driven by one thing: **delivering complex PLM transformations with deep technical excellence, on\-time delivery and proven reliability.**


With 50\+ certified consultants across Europe and India, we are building more than projects, we are building a **Centre of Excellence for PLM architecture and transformation.**


I’m Robin, HR Executive at We.PLM.


I’m searching a recruiter to elevate our talent acquisition in India.


This is where you come in.

#### **Your mission**


As a recruiter you are responsible for hiring best talents in time and offer a smooth candidate experience.


This role demands to support the structuration of recruitment and execute rigorously the policy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Guarantee a clear reference frame in recruitment (recruitment policy, legal, key rules)
* Ensure every candidate has a good experience from hunt/application to onboarding
* Ensure managers apply successfully methodologies
* Support company in attractivity and employee brand
* Defining needs through a clear brief with managers
* Headhunting targeted profiles
* Assessing and evaluating candidates with a standard synthesis
* Support managers in decision making through debrief and score cards
* Ensuring every candidates get a feedback
* Pricing job offers

#### **You might be a great fit if…**

* You have a minimum of 5 years in recruitment including at least 3 years **headhunting** in PLM
* You have a bachelor or a master degree
* You are reliable, rigorous apply precisely methodologies and process defined
* You have an ability to synthesize information
* You conduct processes with proactivity, assertiveness and advisory approach to support managers
* You have good oral communication (clear, structured, concise \& synthetic, precise)
* You have good editorial communication

#### **Why joining We.PLM**

* A high\-expertise environment focused on delivery excellence
* Trainings, access to Dassault Systèmes University and DS certification
* Real career growth opportunities based on your ability to deliver impact and structure transformation
* Direct exposure to clients and strategic projects
* Close collaboration to experienced leaders and founders
* Attractive salary, based on your expertise
* Shared value bonus
* Health insurance
* Flexible working environment
* Strong team culture with team buildings

*Equal opportunities are a priority: we promote inclusion among our employees and provide appropriate accommodations.*

#### **Recruitment path**


HR interview


Manager interview


Final discussion with a director

**Simple. Fast. Transparent.**
